saara.summary: ಸುದ್ದಿ ಸಾರ — the day's text bulletin: index cover → one slide per story → sources and follow. No pictures, ever.
saara.when: Stories with segment "saara". The everyday digest: useful, quick to read, forwarded. Needs Limits.saara_min_stories to Limits.saara_max_stories stories.
saara.notes: Paper & Red (D92). A photograph on a saara story is ignored. Writes saara_01_cover.jpg, saara_02.jpg … saara_NN_sources.jpg, saara_copy.txt and saara_caption.txt.

mukhya.summary: ಮುಖ್ಯ ಸುದ್ದಿ — one breaking or top story: photo cover → ಏನಾಗಿದೆ? → source and corrections.
mukhya.when: Stories with segment "mukhya": breaking news, or the day's story that deserves its own post. Always a picture — a real one first; AI only when the editor was asked and said generate (photo_plan "ai", photo.approved_by).
mukhya.notes: Paper & Red (D92). A breaking story's kicker is the red ಬ್ರೇಕಿಂಗ್ block, computed from published_at, never asserted. Writes mukhya_<k>_01_cover.jpg, _02_points.jpg, _03_source.jpg and mukhya_<k>_copy.txt / _caption.txt.

roundup.summary: ಸ್ಪೀಡ್ ನ್ಯೂಸ್ — the day's stories as one quick-news reel.
roundup.when: Stories with segment "speed": the day's quick hits, three or more. A place and one line per story, spoken by the anchor while it is on screen. A story without a picture gets a type-only frame.
roundup.notes: Each story is cut to its own measured narration (2.8–6.0s), with a counter and one progress segment per story. The wipe moves pictures only: story text is gone before it starts and returns after it lands, so a cut never slices a headline. Laid out in the Reels safe zone, clear of the action rail and the caption. Every word spoken goes through the TTS normaliser; audio is measured and corrected in two passes to -14 LUFS. When the day runs past 45s the tail stories are left out and reported. Paper & Red (D92). Writes roundup_cover.jpg and roundup_caption.txt.

greeting.summary: A festival wish designed as a poster, not a bulletin: centred, gold foil, ornament, signed by the channel.
greeting.when: Festival and occasion wishes only — Gauri-Ganesha, Deepavali, Ugadi, Rajyotsava, Eid, Christmas and the like. Never for news: a news story set in this template reads as a celebration.

limits.themes: sacred lights harvest rajyotsava national serene

greeting.notes: Renders wish_9x16.jpg, wish_4x5.jpg and wish_1x1.jpg plus wish_copy.txt. A photograph MUST declare keep_clear — the band of the image, as fractions of its height, that holds the deity or subject — and no type is ever set inside it: the solver moves the picture, frames it in an arch, or refuses. An AI image is labelled on the poster and in the caption automatically. See DECISIONS.md D54.
